{{Current events|year=2023|month=03|day=9|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[cruise missile]]s at targets across [[Ukraine]]. Buildings and [[critical infrastructure]] are damaged, and at least five [[civilian]]s [[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|were killed]] in [[Lviv Oblast]] when a missile destroyed their home, according to the region's governor [[Maksym Kozytskyy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64897888 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Three [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] gunmen are killed by [[Special forces of Israel|Israeli special units]] during a [[Military operation|operation]] in [[Jenin]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/9/israeli-special-forces-kill-3-palestinians-in-jenin-shoot-out (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/3-islamic-jihad-gunmen-killed-by-undercover-forces-in-northern-west-bank/ (The Times of Israel)]
**Three people are wounded by a shooting on [[Dizengoff Street]], in [[Tel Aviv]]. The perpetrator is killed by [[Israel Police|police]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/9/israeli-emergency-services-say-three-injured-in-tel-aviv-shooting (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Daud Muzamil]], the [[Taliban]]-appointed [[List of governors of Balkh|governor]] of [[Balkh Province]], is killed by an [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] at his office in [[Mazar-i-Sharif]]. Four other people are wounded. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-182409 (TOLO News)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/03/09/Taliban-governor-of-Afghanistan-s-Balkh-province-killed-in-blast-at-his-office (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**Eleven people are killed and four others are injured during an operation to retake territory in north-east [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eleven-soldiers-killed-burkina-fasos-effort-regain-territory-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**At least 25 people are killed when [[Boko Haram]] gunmen storm a fishing village in [[Dikwa]], [[Borno State|Borno]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/islamist-militants-kill-least-25-nigerias-borno-state-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Federal Government of Belgium|Belgian government]] announces a ban on [[gambling advertising]], citing an increase in [[gambling addiction]]. Beginning in 2028, gambling companies will also no longer be able to sponsor professional sports clubs. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belgium-bans-gambling-advertising-july-1-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed and at least 25 others are injured in a [[train wreck|collision]] between a train and a public bus in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/train-rams-into-public-bus-nigerias-lagos-killing-six-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)]
*The wreckage of a [[Cessna 206]] that was reported missing on January 24 in [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]], [[Philippines]], is found in [[Divilacan]], with all six people aboard confirmed dead. Retrieval operations are ongoing. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/03/09/missing-cessna-plane-in-isabela-found-after-month-long-search/ (''Manila Bulletin'')]
*Three people are killed when a mine tunnel collapses in [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-mine-collapse-trapped-workers-a65927b6ee2faf16db6b457f312bf55d (AP)]
*Fourteen people are killed and 54 others are rescued after [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|a boat carrying migrants sinks]] off the [[Tunisia]]n coast. [https://apnews.com/article/tunisia-migrants-dead-boat-sinking-dd64cce6940f8dad5e014cdfbbaa52c6 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Hamburg shooting]]
**Seven people are killed and at least 25 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Jehovah's Witnesses|Jehovah's Witnesses]] centre in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]]. The perpetrator [[kills himself]] [[murder-suicide|after the shooting]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/breaking-police-report-fatal-shooting-and-major-ongoing-operation-in-hamburg/a-64938984 (DW)]
*[[2023 Georgian protests]]
**[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]'s ruling party announces that it will withdraw a controversial bill concerning [[foreign agents]] which prompted days of protests across the country. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/georgia-withdraws-foreign-agent-bill-after-days-of-protests/ar-AA18op1r?OCID=ansmsnnews11 (MSN)]
*[[2023 Matamoros kidnappings]]
**[[Mexico]]'s [[Gulf Cartel]] surrenders five purported perpetrators of last weekend's [[kidnapping]] of four U.S. citizens in [[Matamoros, Tamaulipas]], and offers an apology to the victims, their families, and society in general. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64910394 (BBC News)]
*[[LGBT rights in Uganda]]
**The [[parliament of Uganda]] begins debates on a proposed bill that would [[Criminalization of homosexuality|criminalize]] people identifying as part of the [[LGBTQ community]] with up to 10 years in prison. The bill would also criminalize the "promotion" of [[homosexuality]] and "abetting" or "conspiring" to engage in same-sex relations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-considers-bill-criminalise-identifying-lgbtq-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Capital punishment in Belarus]]
**[[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] signs a bill into law which allows the use of the [[death penalty]] on officials and [[Armed Forces of Belarus|military servicemen]] convicted of [[high treason]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/belarus-approves-death-penalty-officials-convicted-high-treason-3337986 (CNA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 French pension reform strikes]]
**The [[Senate (France)|French Senate]] votes 201–115 to raise the legal [[retirement age]] in [[France]] from 62 to 64 despite mass [[strike action|strikes]] against the change. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-senate-votes-raising-retirement-age-64-2023-03-09/ (Reuters)]
